findings.text: The gate helper's module probe uses `python -I`, and isolated mode ignores both PYTHONPATH and the working directory, so the `# module reckon.crew.query` header line in gate-base.log and gate-head.log records /home/ITER/mcintos/Code/reckon/reckon/crew/query.py, the main checkout, for both arms rather than the tree each arm tested. I confirmed independently that the pytest runs themselves resolve the tree (cwd and PYTHONPATH both pointed at it; the new tests flip FFF at base to green at head), so the measurement is sound, but the header line the manifest contract designates as the module-under-test provenance names the wrong file and would mislead a reader into concluding the gate ran against the main checkout.

The plan declares two negative controls, one for each half of the deliverable: the path-probe half and the ledger-load half (resolve a live row's session with no committed row again, and the ledger.load count rises with the live rows). Only the path-probe control is recorded; negative-control.log and negative_control_note describe the with_path_fields=True mutation only. The ledger-load guard exists as an assertion (tests/test_a_runs_view_checks_only_the_rows_it_returns.py:310, and :226 for the combined arm), but no recorded log demonstrates it reddening when the live-row lookup is removed, so that half of the durability evidence rests on the assertion alone.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_runs_view_checks_only_the_rows_it_returns.py:230 reddens to 162 probes on the demonstrated with_path_fields=True negative control and :224 fails if finalization is dropped, but the ledger-load guard at :310 has no recorded negative control and the equality assertion compares deferred rows against the same _compact_row run with with_path_fields=True.
justifications.evidence: The gate records its arms at 69e555617 (6 failed/380 passed) and 00db5bc56 (3 failed/383 passed), each log ending EXIT=1, and I re-ran the named test in the reviewed tree to 3 passed in 16.65s.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/query.py:259 follows the module's helper idiom and naming (_path_derived, _finalize_paths, _canonical_root, all private, docstrings in the surrounding register) and no added name carries a plan label or version.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/query.py:597 keys the committed-row mapping on (project, _canonical_root(root)) so both arms reach one ledger, and :637 hands each live row a nullary lookup that the ledger source calls only when the pointer and stream leave the session unanswered.
justifications.reuse: Searched reckon/ for a canonical-root helper, a run-id-to-record mapping and a per-project committed-row map: none exists, so _canonical_root and committed_rows are the first owners of their capability, and ledger.index_reuse is an index-reuse region rather than a row mapping.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff 69e555617..3d89fd544 touches only reckon/crew/query.py, reckon/crew/resumption.py, the named test file and the evidence fragment, all inside the manifest's declared write paths.
